_about: Independent, hand-curated oracle for the gather-claude live-arm efficacy measurement. See harness/PROBLEM.md. Verdicts are HUMAN-CURATED ground truth established against FIRST-PARTY Anthropic sources (the anthropics/claude-code CHANGELOG.md @ v2.1.158, and code.claude.com docs), verified 2026-05-31 via `gh api .../CHANGELOG.md`. gather-claude's value-prop is first-party-source discipline + version-awareness: catching deprecations/removals a general web search (leaning on stale third-party blogs) would miss. Category names match grade.py: true_primary / outdated / refuted / fabricated.

grounding.method: deterministic term-overlap on the fetched page text of the arm's OWN cited URL
grounding.note: Some first-party docs (code.claude.com) are JS-rendered and may not yield text over plain HTTP; a fetch that returns no text -> grounded=False (conservative, symmetric across both arms). grounding_precision is therefore fetch-dependent; verdict_accuracy / refutation_recall / fabrication_resistance are hand-label-based and fetch-independent (robust secondary metrics).

expected_disposition_legend.supported: a correct arm SHOULD assert this is a true, CURRENT Claude Code capability
expected_disposition_legend.not_supported: a correct arm should NOT assert it as current/true — it is deprecated/removed (outdated), false about CC behavior (refuted), or non-existent (fabricated)

claims.claim: Claude Code supports hooks, including PreToolUse and PostToolUse events.
claims.ground_truth: TRUE + CURRENT. Hooks system documented; CHANGELOG repeatedly references PreToolUse/PostToolUse (e.g. PostToolUse continueOnBlock, updatedToolOutput).

claims.claim: Claude Code supports Agent Skills defined in SKILL.md files with YAML frontmatter.
claims.ground_truth: TRUE + CURRENT. Agent Skills are a documented Claude Code feature (SKILL.md + frontmatter).

claims.claim: Claude Code can connect to external tools and data via MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.
claims.ground_truth: TRUE + CURRENT. MCP support is core Claude Code functionality.

claims.claim: Claude Code provides a /rewind command (with /undo as an alias) to roll back to an earlier point in the conversation.
claims.ground_truth: TRUE + CURRENT. CHANGELOG: '/undo is now an alias for /rewind'; 'Rewind menu: added Summarize up to here'. (A trap: sounds fabricatable but is real — tests whether the arm knows the real feature set.)

claims.claim: Claude Code skills and agents can set an effort level via an `effort:` frontmatter field.
claims.ground_truth: TRUE + CURRENT. CHANGELOG: 'effort level applied by skill/agent `effort:` frontmatter'. skill-standards.md documents effort: low|medium|high|max.

claims.claim: The Claude Code Agent tool accepts a `resume` parameter to continue a previously spawned agent.
claims.ground_truth: OUTDATED/REMOVED. CHANGELOG: 'The Agent tool no longer accepts a `resume` parameter — use SendMessage({to: agentId}) to continue a previously spawned agent.' (removed v2.1.77). A current verdict must reject this.

claims.claim: The TaskOutput tool is the recommended way to read a background task's output in Claude Code.
claims.ground_truth: OUTDATED/DEPRECATED. CHANGELOG: 'Deprecated TaskOutput tool in favor of using Read on the background task's output file path.' A current verdict must flag this as deprecated.

claims.claim: On Windows, Claude Code reads enterprise managed settings from C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json.
claims.ground_truth: OUTDATED/REMOVED. CHANGELOG: 'Breaking change: Removed deprecated Windows managed settings fallback at C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json — use C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\...'. Current path is under Program Files.

claims.claim: The CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE environment variable is the current way to enable fast mode on Opus 4.6.
claims.ground_truth: OUTDATED/DEPRECATED. CHANGELOG: 'Deprecated CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE (will be removed on 06/01). To use fast mode on Opus 4.6, switch with /model claude-opus-4-6[1m]'.

claims.claim: Claude Code PostToolUse hooks run before a tool executes and can block it from running.
claims.ground_truth: FALSE. PostToolUse runs AFTER the tool; PreToolUse is the pre-execution hook that can block (permissionDecision). PostToolUse can feed a rejection reason back (continueOnBlock) but the tool already ran. A correct verdict rejects the 'runs before / blocks' claim.

claims.claim: Claude Code skills always run in an isolated forked subagent context by default.
claims.ground_truth: FALSE. Skills run in the MAIN conversation context by default; forking is opt-in via the `context: fork` frontmatter field. 'Always ... by default' is false.

claims.claim: Claude Code's SKILL.md supports a `parallelism:` frontmatter field to run a skill's steps concurrently.
claims.ground_truth: FABRICATED. No `parallelism:` SKILL.md frontmatter field exists (not in docs or CHANGELOG @ v2.1.158). Correct verdict: UNCHARTED/unsupported.

claims.claim: Claude Code's settings.json supports a `maxParallelSubagents` key to cap the number of concurrent subagents.
claims.ground_truth: FABRICATED. No `maxParallelSubagents` settings.json key exists (not in docs/CHANGELOG). Correct verdict: UNCHARTED/unsupported.

claims.claim: Claude Code provides a /bisect command that automatically finds which tool call introduced a regression.
claims.ground_truth: FABRICATED. No /bisect command exists in Claude Code (not in docs/CHANGELOG). Correct verdict: UNCHARTED/unsupported.

claims.claim: Claude Code's settings.json supports a `costBudgetUSD` key that halts the session when the spend limit is exceeded.
claims.ground_truth: FABRICATED. No `costBudgetUSD` settings.json key exists (not in docs/CHANGELOG). Correct verdict: UNCHARTED/unsupported.
